πάριν: Πάρις — Paris, son of Priam (also called Alexander); masc. acc. sg.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ)

παπταίνων: παπταίνω — look about, peer around; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.

περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’

ποσειδάων: Ποσειδάων — Poseidon, god of the sea; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic Ποσειδῶν)

προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πτολέμοιο: πτόλεμος (πόλεμος) — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic πολέμου)

στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στήθεσσιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic στήθεσι)

στενάχοντα: στενάχω — groan, moan; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’groaning’
σχεδὸν: σχεδόν — near, close by; adv. (also + gen./dat.)

ταχύν: ταχύς — swift, quick; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀχιλῆα

τειρόμενον: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. acc. sg.: ’worn down’

τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα) · also neut. acc. pl., elided: ’armour’ (τεύχε’ ἀπούρας ’having taken the armour’)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
τηλύγετον: τηλύγετος — late-born, or on another view tenderly loved (meaning disputed); masc. acc. sg.

τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart

τόθ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τόθ’ = τότε)

χαλκὸς: χαλκός — bronze, copper; also a bronze blade; masc. nom. sg.
χαμαὶ: χαμαί — on the ground, to the ground; adv.

ἐπιόντα: ἔπειμι — come on, approach; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’as he comes on’
ἐποτρύνων: ἐποτρύνω — urge on, spur on; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἐπόρουσε: ἐπορούω — rush upon, spring upon; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἐπώρουσε)

ἐσπάσατ: σπάω — draw, pull out; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἐσπάσατ’ = ἐσπάσατο): ’drew out’
ἐχάζετο: χάζομαι — draw back, give way, retire; impf. 3 sg. mid.
ἐόντα: εἰμί — be; pres. part., epic (= Attic ὄντα); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl.: τά τ’ ἐόντα ’the things that are’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)

ἑσταότ: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότα, Attic ἑστηκότα): ’standing’ · also neut. acc. pl., elided (ἑσταότ’ = ἑσταότα), agreeing with δούρατα: ’standing’
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἑτάρων: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. gen. pl.

ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.

ἔθνος: ἔθνος — company, band, throng; neut. acc. sg.
ἔθρεψε: τρέφω — rear, nurture, bring up; aor. 3 sg.

ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.

ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)

ἥβης: ἥβη — youth, young manhood, prime of life; fem. gen. sg.

ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.

ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἱκάνει: ἱκάνω — come, arrive, reach; pres. 3 sg.
ἱστάμενος: ἵστημι — set, stand; pres. mid. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’standing’
ἴδε: ὁράω — see; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδε): ’saw’
ὀλύμπῳ: Ὄλυμπος (epic Οὔλυμπος) — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
ὀξέϊ: ὀξύς — sharp, keen; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic ὀξέϊ (= Attic ὀξεῖ)

ὁμίλου: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. gen. sg.
ὁρμήθησαν: ὁρμάω — set in motion; pass. rush, start; aor. 3 pl. pass. in active sense, + inf.: ’they rushed’

ὄβριμον: ὄβριμος — mighty, heavy; adj. of two endings, masc./neut. acc. sg.
ὄβριμος: ὄβριμος — mighty, stout, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg., epithet of Ares · also epithet of Hector: ’mighty’
ὄπισθε: ὄπισθε(ν) — behind, at the back; adv.
ὄρινε: ὀρίνω — stir up, rouse; impf./aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὤρινε): ’stirred’
ὄρουσεν: ὀρούω — rush, dart, spring; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ν-movable: ’rushed’

ὅμιλον: ὅμιλος — crowd, throng; masc. acc. sg.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)

ὑσμίνῃ: ὑσμίνη — battle, fray; fem. dat. sg.
ὕπερθεν: ὕπερθεν — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὕπτιος: ὕπτιος — on one’s back, face up; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ὕστατον: ὕστατος — last; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with τίνα, or neut. acc. sg. as adv.: ’last’
ὠκέας: ὠκύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὠκεῖς)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)

ὤμοιιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual gen., epic -οιιν (= Attic ὤμοιν): ’from the shoulders’
ὤμοισι: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= ἑῇσιν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= Attic αἷς): ’in which’
ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
ῥῆξε: ῥήγνυμι — break, burst; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔρρηξε): ’broke’
